C0576.title: Eight Individuals Convicted of False Advertising for Organizing Fake Reviews and Sales
C0576.summary: In July 2025, the Dunhua City People Court in Jilin concluded a click-farming and reputation manipulation case. Defendants including Xiaoming bought click-farming software, set up studios, and organized workers to conduct fake transactions and positive reviews for Taobao merchants. The platform operated by Xiaoming and four others illegally earned 272,000 yuan, while the platform operated by Xiaohong and two others illegally earned about 208,500 yuan. The court convicted eight defendants of false advertising, sentenced them to imprisonment or detention, imposed fines, and confiscated all illegal proceeds.
